name: p03-elt-dashboard
_comment_typescript: Pinned to 5.x. Nothing here imports TypeScript, but svelte2tsx declares it as a peer at ^4.9.4 || ^5.0.0 while ts-node asks only for >=2.7 — so npm resolves TypeScript 7, svelte2tsx rejects it, and the whole install fails. The override forces one version both accept.
